reviews.title: Great value
reviews.comment: This mouse offers great value for the price. It feels comfortable in hand, has responsive controls, and the RGB lighting adds a nice gaming aesthetic. The multiple programmable buttons are very useful for gaming shortcuts and productivity. Overall, a solid budget gaming mouse with good performance and features

reviews.title: Great gaming mouse without breaking the bank!
reviews.comment: Great mouse for the price! the design is somewhat of the cookie cutter, albeit comfortable shape. The wheel glides effortlessly but not so much that it over scrolls. Will say the clicks are a little TOOOO sensitive. If you're playing a game and holding down left click, just ever so slightly brushing right click will make it also click..as well as just the accidental bump when click sliding can be a small issue until you adjust to it. It's nothing extraordinary but does it's job just fine. The extra keys compared to the normal gaming mouse of this caliber is actually super awesome and being able to re-map those to whatever key/effect is super handy! RGB on it is bright and proud. Overall great mouse that I would purchase again in the future.
reviews.author: nicholas perry
